card.name: Space before a statistic in development texts
card.fires_on: The space just before a number, usually a percentage or count, in texts on development, poverty, health and South or Southeast Asian countries. It also fires inside number ranges such as 85-90 or 2007-2012.

modes.label: Space before a percentage
modes.description: The gap right before a figure that is followed by percent or per cent, in statements about growth, literacy or disease.

modes.label: Inside a number range
modes.description: The dash or digit within a range of years or percentages.
